notes.diagnosis_zh: 复数门参数和 float16 输入仍正确拒绝；最后一条旧断言要求拒绝向量参数，但实际广播结果为 float32 的 cos([0.2,0.3])。没有修改这条未获授权的旧断言，也不关闭已实现广播来制造通过。

notes.diagnosis: Complex gate parameters and float16 still refuse correctly. The final old assertion requires vector rejection, while actual float32 broadcasting returns cos([0.2,0.3]). This unapproved assertion remains unchanged; working broadcasting is not disabled for green checks.
notes.next: Verify broadcast shape, dtype, values and derivatives, then propose migration of only the final broadcast rejection while preserving complex and float16 refusals.

notes.next_zh: 继续完整回归和逐函数合同审核；保留符号编译、重复调用、无主机回调、资源上限和真正三阶拒绝门禁。

Admitted pure static numeric sources now replay inline into caller AD; all six combinations match the original independent rotation oracle in both profiles. Original mathematics is unchanged; the four other nested-cache failures are not repaired by this result.
notes.next: Continue full regression and per-function contract review, retaining symbolic compilation, repeated calls, no host callbacks, resource limits and genuine third-order refusal.

notes.diagnosis: Both Native constant and Variable inputs match the independent generator oracle within 1.3e-15. Both pinned PennyLane versions throw TypeError for the constant and pass the Variable path. The original strict failure is retained; Native does not copy the reference defect.
notes.next: Propose only a reference-observation contract migration, retaining constant input, independent Native mathematics and Variable comparison without changing interfaces or tolerances.

notes.next: Continue full regression and exclude the migrated file from unchanged-test counts, preserving before/after hashes and exact approval scope.

notes.diagnosis: The old assertion demands rejection of parameter-shift at value execution. A separate strict probe now matches the independent stored values, Jacobians and Hessians for the fractional-power and both controlled cases. This is Native parameter-shift execution, not acceptance of a pure tensor specialization or of the complete method contract.
notes.next: Finish both-profile method, provenance and resource acceptance, then propose an explicit migration of only this rejection case. Keep the old assertion failing until approved; do not disable working functionality to obtain green checks.

A probe separated the two categories and garbage collection did not remove the binding balance; actual ownership and release must still be audited.
notes.next: Trace each retained binding allowance to the mathematical snapshot and its aliases; verify terminal release and parent-budget competition before deciding whether this is a lifetime defect or an old counting-contract conflict. Do not remove valid reservations or loosen the assertion.
